clips.title: The story
paras: Zoram'gar Outpost is a fortified Horde beachhead nestled on the western edge of Ashenvale along the Zoram Strand. Serving as a crucial coastal encampment, it provides the Horde with access to the Veiled Sea and keeps watch over regional threats like the encroaching naga and the sinister depths nearby.

Situated at the northwestern lip of Ashenvale where the primeval forest collapses into the sea, Zoram'gar Outpost serves as the Horde's isolated coastal footing on the Zoram Strand. Hemmed in by night elf territory inland and maritime hazards offshore, the encampment acts as a staging ground for scouts, hunters, and shaman tasked with tracking local dangers. Life at the outpost is an endless vigil: naga regularly prowl the shallows, while lurking cultists and primal horrors pulse from the subterranean cavern system known as Blackfathom Deeps just down the shore.
